source: declared — Growth Factor AI is our own brand. Direction from Ben: burnt orange (ref jonmayo.com) on super dark blue, kept simple, rounded corners throughout.
title: Growth Factor AI
note: jonmayo.com is blocked from this build environment, so --ember is a considered pick against 'more burnt, a little lighter than #C9622E', not a sampled value. Confirm against the real site.
accent_gradient: linear-gradient(94deg, #D2763F, #E3A055) — used only on the hero accent line and the logo mark. Set --accent-grad to var(--ember) for a flat accent instead.

type.utility: JetBrains Mono — used for exactly one thing: the typing line
type.hosting: self-hosted variable woff2, latin subset, in site/assets/fonts/

geometry.radius: rounded everywhere, Claude-style — 8px controls, 12px media/notes, 16px panels. No sharp corners on anything.
geometry.shell: 900px, centred — the shell is the reading measure

motion: The typing line — 'Build your own ___.' types in and back out, with a blinking caret. This is the ONE animated thing on the site and the piece Ben specifically liked.
Nothing else. No scroll reveals, no drawing diagrams, no marquee.
history: v1 was rejected as far too busy: label rails, hairline spines, grid meshes, node/edge diagrams, a ticker, scroll reveals and zero-radius everything. Stripped back to this. Keep it basic.
